# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a comfortable tech job to pursue entrepreneurship and self-directed projects.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered tool orchestrating autonomous software development with Claude, integrating Linear tickets and Git workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice guide covering color wheels, harmony schemes, perceptual spaces, and practical design principles.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canal theories to modern spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Fermentation](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Explores sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques for home bakers.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Mechanism](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked celestial movements using sophisticated mechanical engineering.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through critical periods, auditory feedback, and neural circuits similar to human speech development.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and why Web Mercator dominates online maps.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, deep-sea camouflage strategies, and the revolutionary discovery of green fluorescent protein.
- [Roman Concrete Durability](https://www.justinhe.com/i): Why Roman concrete structures survived millennia while modern concrete fails faster due to superior volcanic ash ingredients and self-healing properties.
